proposal.summary: Multiple unauthenticated/insufficient authorization API endpoints in Global RADAR BSA Radar 1.6.7234.24750 and lower allow changing other users' passwords, modifying other users' profiles (including stored XSS in name fields), and enumerating arbitrary user account details via UserID.
proposal.cwe_quote: The Global RADAR BSA Radar 1.6.7234.X application lacks valid authorization controls in multiple functions while logged into the application.

PR.quote: The UserID and NewPassword parameters can be forged to force the password change of another existing user account by using their UserID.

C.quote: Allows the ability to update the password belonging to another account by their UserID, and therefore leading to account takeover.

I.quote: Allows the ability to update the password belonging to another account by their UserID, and therefore leading to account takeover.

A.quote: Allows the ability to update the password belonging to another account by their UserID, and therefore leading to account takeover.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the ChangePassword, SaveUserProfile, and GetUser API requests against an up-to-date test instance to confirm whether authentication is required and whether authorization checks validate the acting user; collect request/response pairs and determine affected endpoints and required privileges.

evidence_quotes.quote: The Global RADAR BSA Radar 1.6.7234.X application lacks valid authorization controls in multiple functions while logged into the application.

evidence_quotes.claim: Change password allows changing another account by UserID
evidence_quotes.quote: The UserID and NewPassword parameters can be forged to force the password change of another existing user account by using their UserID.

evidence_quotes.claim: SaveUserProfile allows updating other user profile fields and stored XSS
evidence_quotes.quote: Allows the ability to update the user profile belonging to another account by using their UserID. This includes modifiable details like first name, last name, email, and phone number. This also allows for injection of a Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) into arbitrary user account profiles as the first name and last name parameters are vulnerable.

The UserID paramter can be forged to enumerate over existing userID's in order to return their account details such as full name, username, user permissions, account role, email, and password question.
